scope: Ten read-only ROUTE/TABLE canonical cases using the current dedicated browser session and the two exact owned Scripts from batch05 as rows/details. No data creation, deletion, edit, clone, Task, Run, User, Group, Node, or Agent action in this batch.

session_reuse.fixture_source: batch05/owned-ledger.json; original Script and Clone remain unchanged during this batch

cases.actions: Direct-open /sign-in, refresh once, then exercise browser back/forward against the actual post-session route.
cases.request_oracle: Real GET /api/me status; do not print auth headers/body. Observe any actual OIDC/config request separately if emitted.
cases.ui_oracle: Observe whether authenticated /sign-in redirects to / per safeRedirect, record final route, main ready/error/empty state, and history behavior. No login/logout and no invalid-credential writes.

cases.actions: Direct-open /groups, refresh, navigate via actual sidebar link away and back, then back/forward.
cases.request_oracle: GET /api/groups and /api/nodes status/count, filtered to safe counts only.
cases.ui_oracle: Ready, EmptyState/table, search-toolbar presence, and route/history state must agree with actual returned count. Do not expect a table/search toolbar for a truly empty list.

cases.actions: Direct-open /scripts, refresh, follow the actual owned Script detail link, then browser back/forward.
cases.request_oracle: GET /api/scripts 200 with two owned rows; store only count and owned-ID match booleans.
cases.ui_oracle: List header, two rows, fields, loading/ready/error/empty classification, and back/forward route consistency.

cases.actions: Direct-open /scripts/new, refresh, follow sidebar/list back to /scripts, and browser back/forward. Do not save or cancel with writes.
cases.request_oracle: Record actual same-origin GETs, if any; confirm zero POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
cases.ui_oracle: New Script title, default fields, required name, form ready state, and route/history behavior.

cases.actions: Direct-open each existing owned Script ID from the batch05 ledger, refresh each, follow actual list/detail links, then browser back/forward.
cases.request_oracle: GET /api/scripts/:owned and /api/scripts/:owned/revisions statuses; verify the returned IDs match only the ledgered IDs and record revision counts/hashes, never content bodies.
cases.ui_oracle: Editor ready fields, Revision History presence/content sections, Error/Not Found handling only if naturally returned; zero mutations.

cases.actions: Direct-open /tasks, refresh, use actual sidebar navigation away/back, then browser back/forward.
cases.request_oracle: GET /api/tasks status/count; do not create or edit a Task.
cases.ui_oracle: Observe actual table/EmptyState/ErrorState and route/history; do not infer Task functionality from form presence.

cases.actions: Search the original and copy names separately, search a guaranteed non-match, then use actual Reset/clear.
cases.request_oracle: Real GET /api/scripts count remains two; filtering should remain client-side and emit no mutation.
cases.ui_oracle: Each exact owned row hit, zero-result UI, Reset restores both rows, and no-write request count.

cases.actions: Click the Name header through fresh snapshot refs to exercise ascending, descending, and clear-sort behavior.
cases.request_oracle: No write requests; list GET remains unchanged.
cases.ui_oracle: Compare visible two-row order after each click; if the table does not expose a clear-sort state, mark that subdimension PARTIAL.

cases.actions: Hide Interpreter, reload and verify hidden state/column, then restore it and reload once more.
cases.request_oracle: No server writes; inspect only the `nodesteer.table.scripts` visibility boolean.
cases.ui_oracle: Column header/cell disappears, remains hidden after reload, then reappears after restore; verify both rows remain.

cases.actions: Change pageSize from 10 to 20 using the actual control, reload, and verify the selected size and rows.
cases.request_oracle: GET /api/scripts count remains two; no mutations.
cases.ui_oracle: Verify persisted pageSize and row count. Next/previous/first/last behavior remains PARTIAL because only two owned rows exist and no extra records may be created.

shared_evidence.each_route: Fresh agent-browser snapshot/ref actions; capture same-origin method/path/status, URL, main ready/error/empty classification and row/count oracle after each navigation/refresh/back/forward.
shared_evidence.each_table_case: Fresh snapshot refs for controls, actual visible row/header order, relevant API count, and zero mutation assertion.
shared_evidence.secrets: Never save raw requests, headers, token, Script content or secret defaults; allowlisted status/count/ID-match booleans/hash only.
shared_evidence.resources: Retain exactly two owned Scripts for this read-only batch. No API write fallback, cleanup, or status change until next approved stage.
